XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Airbag control unit

  • Fault: Airbag warning light illuminates (yellow then red) and a generic fault code, with the Start&Stop system failing to operate

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty airbag control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the airbag control unit; repair or replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Following the replacement, it was necessary to carry out a Proxy alignment using diagnostic equipment, due to the odometer flashing. The service permanently resolved the problem.
    The component is located in the passenger compartment, on the centre tunnel; it is accessible from beneath the left-hand storage compartment, after removing a plastic cover.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.5 h.
